title: Jim Starlin
description:
An Imperial scout on a speeder bike is attacked by some brave, feisty Ewoks in this humorous illustration. Comments artist Jim Starlin: "l saw all three STAR WARS movies and didn't climb up into a bell tower with a scoped rifle." Starlin started working in comics in 1971. Since then he's contributed to CAPTAIN MARVEL, WARLOCK, THE INFINITY GAUNTLET TRILOGY, SUPERMAN, BATMAN, DREADSTAR, and a pair of novels with Daina Graziunas: AMONG MADMEN and LADY EL. He recently developed a trilogy mini-series for Bravura entitled BREED.

PHOTO. Dion Ogust
